description: This Java source file defines the NfcProvisioningFragment class, which provides UI and logic for NFC provisioning in an Android app. It manages user input for provisioning parameters, creates NFC messages with provisioning data, and handles loading of initial provisioning values.

classes.name: NfcProvisioningFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that manages NFC provisioning by creating NFC messages with device setup parameters and handling user input for provisioning data.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components and binds event handlers.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets up NFC callback and initializes data loader.

methods.name: createNdefMessage
methods.description: Creates an NFC NdefMessage containing provisioning data in MIME format.

methods.name: onTextChanged
methods.description: Updates provisioning values based on user input.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a loader to fetch initial provisioning values.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Populates UI with loaded provisioning values.
